title: 1 Year Later, Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Finally Gets a Streaming Date (But There’s a Catch)
content: Following the historic success of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle film, fans will finally get to watch it on streaming services. Ufotable announced a trilogy film series to adapt the manga’s most intense arc. So far, only the first installment has been released, and it ran in the theatres for almost a month.
author: ComicBook

title: NABETAMA: Getting Shots on a Frying Pan TV Anime by J.C. STAFF Announced for 2027
content: The nonfiction gourmet manga NABETAMA: Getting Shots on a Frying Pan ( Nabe ni Dangan o Ukenagara ) is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with studio J.C.STAFF in charge of the animation. It is set to release in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Webtoon-Based Agent Kim Reactivated Series Reveals Trailer, Global Netflix Release on June 26
content: Agent Kim Reactivated , the live-action adaptation of the Manager Kim webtoon, will launch globally on Netflix on June 26, with an official trailer unveiled alongside the announcement on June 15. The series will also debut on Korean broadcasting studio SBS on June 26.
author: ANN

title: Dr. Stone: Science Future (Season 4) Reveals Episode 37 (Finale) Preview
content: Dr. Stone: Science Future (Season 4) revealed the preview for its final episode, Episode 37, which premieres on June 25. The anime premiered on April 2 , with Shuhei Matsushuita directing at TMS Entertainment.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Cyborg 009: Nemesis' Reveals Additional Staff, Main Promo, Ending Theme
content: The official website of the Cyborg 009: Nemesis anime series revealed additional staff, a key visual (pictured), ending theme, and the main promo on Thursday. The anime adapting Shoutarou Ishinomori 's action sci-fi manga will begin streaming on July 19.

content: The official website for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga announced two more cast members for the film on Thursday.

title: Arc System Works Announces Qliphah in Providence's Shadow Game
content: Arc System Works announced the new Qliphah in Providence's Shadow game during the " ARC SYSTEM WORKS Showcase 2026 - June 24th" livestream on Wednesday. The game will launch for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store on September 24.
